crossRefs.note: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

translations.web: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.
translations.bsb: They are joined to one another; they clasp and cannot be separated.
translations.kjv: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
translations.asv: They are joined one to another; They stick together, so that they cannot be sundered.
